name: Daniel Street Tavern
description: Daniel Street Tavern is a lively and unpretentious karaoke bar known for its friendly atmosphere and extensive song selection. Regulars and visitors alike enjoy the vibrant karaoke nights, which feature a great sound system and a welcoming crowd. The venue offers a no-frills experience with cheap drinks, pool tables, and a fun shot wheel, making it a favorite local spot for karaoke enthusiasts seeking a genuine, community-driven vibe.
